notes.title: New character "Clarice Arcanart" Available
notes.notes:
■New Character "Clarisse Arcanart"
She demonstrates her true value when paired with characters who deal skill damage like "Belladonna" and "Tia," as she can increase the skill damage of ally characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172665/b957fc6912f813b0319ca48092f3f6794e01bf03.jpg[/img]

*Belladonna's Skill: Deals damage to all enemies at the end of each turn
*Tia's Skill: Deals damage to all enemies at the end of the turn when deployed
